description: This file defines a final class 'RequestOptions' in the GuzzleHttp namespace that contains a list of constants representing various request options for the Guzzle HTTP client. It documents the purpose and expected data types for each option, serving as a reference for configuring HTTP requests.

classes.name: RequestOptions
classes.description: A class containing constants for Guzzle HTTP request options, each representing a specific configuration setting for HTTP requests.

methods.name: ALLOW_REDIRECTS
methods.description: Constant for the allow_redirects option controlling redirect behavior.

methods.name: AUTH
methods.description: Constant for the auth option passing HTTP authentication parameters.

methods.name: BODY
methods.description: Constant for the body option specifying the request body.

methods.name: CERT
methods.description: Constant for the cert option specifying SSL client certificate.

methods.name: COOKIES
methods.description: Constant for the cookies option indicating cookie usage.

methods.name: CONNECT_TIMEOUT
methods.description: Constant for the connect_timeout option specifying connection timeout.

methods.name: CRYPTO_METHOD
methods.description: Constant for the crypto_method option specifying TLS version.

methods.name: DEBUG
methods.description: Constant for the debug option enabling debug output.

methods.name: DECODE_CONTENT
methods.description: Constant for the decode_content option for automatic content decoding.

methods.name: DELAY
methods.description: Constant for the delay option specifying delay before sending.

methods.name: EXPECT
methods.description: Constant for the expect option controlling the 'Expect: 100-Continue' behavior.

methods.name: FORM_PARAMS
methods.description: Constant for form_params setting form data.

methods.name: HEADERS
methods.description: Constant for headers specifying HTTP headers.

methods.name: HTTP_ERRORS
methods.description: Constant to control HTTP error exception throwing.

methods.name: IDN_CONVERSION
methods.description: Constant for idn_conversion handling IDNA support.

methods.name: JSON
methods.description: Constant for json data encoding.

methods.name: MULTIPART
methods.description: Constant for multipart form data.

methods.name: ON_HEADERS
methods.description: Constant for callbacks invoked on receiving headers.

methods.name: ON_STATS
methods.description: Constant for transfer statistics callback.

methods.name: PROGRESS
methods.description: Constant for transfer progress callback.

methods.name: PROXY
methods.description: Constant for proxy settings.

methods.name: QUERY
methods.description: Constant for query string parameters.

methods.name: SINK
methods.description: Constant for response data sink.

methods.name: SYNCHRONOUS
methods.description: Constant for synchronous request setting.

methods.name: SSL_KEY
methods.description: Constant for SSL key specification.

methods.name: STREAM
methods.description: Constant for enabling response streaming.

methods.name: VERIFY
methods.description: Constant for SSL certificate verification behavior.

methods.name: TIMEOUT
methods.description: Constant for request timeout.

methods.name: READ_TIMEOUT
methods.description: Constant for read timeout setting.

methods.name: VERSION
methods.description: Constant for HTTP protocol version.

methods.name: FORCE_IP_RESOLVE
methods.description: Constant for forcing IP protocol version (IPv4 or IPv6).
